text:
This is a post-meal photo. What remains is a nearly full cup of coffee with milk, crumbs and egg residue on the plate, empty muffin liners, empty butter/jam packets, and a little water. I counted the coffee with milk (~200 g, ~60 kcal) plus small residues (~10 g, ~20 kcal), for a total of about 80 kcal and 210 g.
